row:
World-class, hands-on continuing education for veterinary & medical professionals.

Advancing the field of medicine for veterinary and medical professionals takes a passion for excellence, a dedication to practitioners and their patients, and a commitment to providing the highest quality continuing education available. 

Since 1928, Viticus Group has established itself as a leader in our field, with the foresight and vision to become a world leader in continuing medical education for all veterinary and medical professionals. Striving toward a mission of enhancing animal and human health worldwide, Viticus Group is steadfast in our efforts to move medicine forward into a healthy future while demonstrating a relentless commitment to patient care. As healthcare providers, you treat your patients like family. At Viticus Group, we consider you part of ours.
